preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Input consists of non-empty lines only (no empty lines).

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: First line is a valid integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if i % 2 == 2 and (n := int(stdin.splitlines()[i-1].strip())) >= 1 and n <= 10**6)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly n space-separated integers (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), where n is given in the preceding line.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if i % 2 == 2)
preconditions.description: All numbers in the sequence are integers between 1 and 10^9 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == n for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if i % 2 == 2 and (n := int(stdin.splitlines()[i-1].strip())) >= 1)
preconditions.description: All numbers in each sequence are distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == ['YES' if all(abs(a.index(x) - sorted_a.index(x)) <= 1 for x in a) else 'NO' for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if i % 2 == 2 and (a := list(map(int, line.split()))) and (sorted_a := sorted(a))]
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if and only if every element in the input sequence is at most 1 position away from its correct position in the sorted sequence. The correct position is determined by the sorted order of the sequence.
